assertions.name: SCOPE-(a) REFUTATION for small eps: the amplitude-form step FAILS along the DN tail evolution during the cascade-front transient — D_eff goes strongly negative at eps <= 1e-2 (interior tail production beats dissipation + boundary accounting), while holding at eps = 1e-1
assertions.source: min D_eff: +14.8 at eps=1e-1 (0 violations) but -22.1 at eps=1e-2 (682/3575 steps) and -23.1 at eps=1e-3 (3544/18567), all at t~0.32 — the cascade-front passage. The boundary_flux_tail_bound Lean theorem stands as a conditional; its in-model instantiation via THIS step form (single boundary amplitude, naive floor D) is refuted, scope (a): this form, this band, alone. The correct effective step must account interior production.

description: SF6 (bean qou-g0dl): probe-level validation of the amplitude-form step hypothesis of boundary_flux_tail_bound (PR #5058) — dOmega_tail/dt <= F*a - D*Omega_tail with a = u_{B+1}, F = 2 k_{B+1}^3 u_B^2 (the DN boundary coupling). Measures the effective damping D_eff pointwise along unforced DN runs (N=32, B=8, band-limited data, T=50 eddy) across eps; the step is validated iff min_t D_eff > 0. The named risk is the tail's interior cascade production (not sign-definite) vs tail dissipation. Scope (a); float64 RK2 exploratory tier; the Lean chain's remaining full-NS caveat (nonlocal transfer) is untouched by this probe.
